violationSemantics.V1: class-level enumeration: every `implements Output` class in src/main/java (top-level + nested) must be in implementationClasses; a new class not in the registry = red
violationSemantics.V2: stale class: a registry implementation class no longer `implements Output` in live source = red (forces honest registry maintenance)
violationSemantics.V3: behavior drift: collect(OutputTag) method-body classification (scanner: {forward, fail-fast, no-op}) vs registry class classification ({forward, fail-fast, pinned-known-violation}). Body classification precedence: forward (consumer.accept( / other .collect( / .accept() > fail-fast (throw) > no-op (empty body / comments only). Match rule: body no-op + registry pinned-known-violation -> violation emitted and absorbed by transition pin (green overall); any other body != registry -> red. ChainingOutput (throw + consumer.accept) = forward (fail-fast is a sub-semantic); TimestampedCollector (output.collect(...)) = forward; RecordWriterOutput / BroadcastingRecordWriterOutput (empty body) = no-op.
violationSemantics.V4: new emission point: call-site scan = (a) extract OutputTag<...> name declarations (field / local variable / method parameter three forms; regexes: OutputTag<[^>]*>\s+(?:final\s+)?(\w+) and parameter-list \(\s*(?:final\s+)?OutputTag<[^>]*>\s+(\w+)) -> (b) match emission calls \.collect\(\s*<name>\s*, (name in declared OutputTag variables) -> (c) exclusion rule: calls inside Output implementation class method bodies (e.g. TimestampedCollector.java:98, parameter-form OutputTag) are NOT V4 - governed by V1/V3 -> (d) emission points (non-implementation classes) must be a subset of emissionPoints table; new emission point = red. Method declaration lines (void output(OutputTag, X)) and internal helper calls (e.g. WindowOperator.java:600 sideOutput(element)) do not match .collect( and are naturally excluded. Registry line semantics = emission point (the call line), same as scan output line.
violationSemantics.V5: stale emission point: a registry emission point no longer present in live code = red (refactored/moved emission points must sync the registry)
violationSemantics.pinMatching: violations subset of mjs-pins.json pinnedViolations (p.key exact-match against the scanner's violation string) = green; pins are only allowed to cover cross-task instance classes (V1/V3 categories); a pin whose violation no longer exists = stale-pin error
